name: Caelian di Soliastres

items.name: Traveling Robes
items.description: Finely tailored dark-grey robes embroidered with silver thread. Lightweight and well-made; comfortable enough to sleep in.

items.name: Silver-Capped Walking Staff
items.description: An ornate walking staff with a silver cap shaped like a crescent. Doubles as an arcane focus.

items.name: Dagger
items.description: Plain steel dagger carried in a concealed sleeve sheath.

items.name: Ring of Protection +1
items.description: A thin silver band set with a chip of obsidian. Grants a +1 enhancement bonus to all saves.

items.name: Circlet of Intellect +2
items.description: A slender platinum circlet with inlaid sapphire runes. Grants a +2 enhancement bonus to Intelligence.

items.name: Wand of Disguise Self
items.description: A slim ivory wand with 15 charges of Disguise Self.

items.name: Spellbook
items.description: A leather-bound travel spellbook, edges scuffed from long use. The handwriting changes style every few pages.

items.name: Component Pouch
items.description: A belt-slung pouch of spell components. Replenished at any town with an apothecary.

items.name: Doppelganger Traits
items.description: DM-only. Immune to sleep and charm. Reads surface thoughts. Shapeshifts into any humanoid. Surprise on 1-4. Saves as level 10. Currently wearing the face of Caelian di Soliastres, minor Soliastres cousin -- a cover that holds up to a casual inquiry but not a determined investigation.

notes: Currently traveling with the party as a helpful arcane ally. Presents as a soft-spoken Soliastres minor cousin who was disinherited and turned to the adventuring life for coin and connections. In truth a doppelganger with his own agenda -- still being determined by the DM, but likely involves identifying which party member is most isolated and useful to replace later. Plays the quiet scholar. Offers spells, information, and the occasional clever plan; never volunteers for the front rank.
